title: DSP fast walkers
summary: Max tells of DSP fast walkers, about an unknown time at Earth orbit, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Probably the fast walkers that the DSP.

plain: A guest named Max, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about NASA and the Moon, points to what are called fast walkers: fast-moving unknown objects picked up by DSP, the US military's early-warning satellites that watch for missile launches. Max says these are probably what is being talked about, suggesting the satellites have caught unexplained things moving through space near Earth.
